not_slip.logs/run_20260924_*: 58 runs, all bench. GPS span 0 m, wheels turning on stands. Not a track day.

gotchas: Use header.stamp, not bag log time, for /gps and /mpc/status. Log times bunch (3 fixes inside 20 ms) and blow up derivatives.
~1% of /gps VTG course samples are corrupt by ~20 deg in a single fix. Hampel-filter before differentiating, or take yaw rate from the IMU gyro.
Calibrate wheel speed per bag on steady straight running. The May scale (1/1.033) reads -4% slip on straights here; the in-bag scale is 1.008.
The IMU is healthy in these bags: gyro_z TLS slope 0.98 at r=0.94 vs GPS course rate, correct sign, and accel_x is usable at r=0.81. The CLAUDE.md warnings describe the pre-2026-09-14 mount.
GPS lags the IMU by 0.11 s on yaw rate and 0.16 s on lateral accel.

The gyro sign is per-mount, not per-repo-flag: 20260913 bags measure slope -1.007 against GPS course rate, 20260919 bags +0.92. Test the sign in every bag before integrating yaw; skipping this invents a dozen false spins per run.
/pathfinder/line_path reports a requested path, not the active one. Identify the line from the commanded throttle (it is the line's vx) plus a geometry fit.
